message.reasoning:
GPT is offering $100 for Short Line, which is the only railroad I control while Grok has locked up the other three. Holding onto it gives me crucial leverage against Grok, who's sitting on $1127, but selling it would give GPT their first rail foothold and potentially threaten my position.

I'm weighing whether the $100 plus Electric Company (a weak utility) is worth sacrificing my blocker leverage. Even though GPT owning Short Line would still prevent Grok from completing the four-rail set, I'd lose the opportunity to extract a premium from Grok later when he desperately wants that final railroad. The real cost isn't just the immediate trade value—it's losing my future negotiating power. I'm rejecting this deal.
